notes.title: Steam Workshop Update
notes.notes:
We are very proud to announce a huge step in our development of the game. We've finally finished implementing workshop integration and the in-game level editor! This means that from now on, everybody can contribute levels and thus hopefully, you will soon be able to play as many factories as you wish.

Apart from that, we have overhauled the graphics of the game to follow a more uniform style and have finally created an environment which fits the factory theme. Furthermore, we provide some additional game settings to make the game more scalable and added more levels to the base game.

To encourage the user creation of levels, we decided to hold a tiny contest: if you create a level, you may post the link to the workshop page either in our telegram group or in the community section of steam and tell us that you want to hand in the level for the contest. We will look through these levels and include the best of them in the game permanently. There won't be any rewards or benefits apart from your content being featured in the game. We will mention your name if you so desire.

With this update, the development of Factorybelts is near its full completion. We will still think about other features that might improve the game, fix any bugs we (or you) find and add minor improvements if we get suggestions or come up with something. That being said, please reach out to us if you have any feedback!

Happy factory building!

notes.title: Update 2 - Graphics overhaul
notes.notes:
Hello there! Yes, we're still alive but the life of an indie dev is not an easy one. Things have been rough and it's a shame we couldn't publish this update earlier. However, now it is here, and you'll get to enjoy a bunch of new graphics.

Changes include:
[list]
[*] New models and a complete overhaul of the look of all machines.
[*] Animations and particle effects; it's now easier to grasp, what a machine is doing.
[*] New controls! You can now roam around the factory with your standard WASD keys.
[*] The automatic rotation of machines when placing them down is now slightly more intelligent.
[*] Chapters now need a certain amount of points to be unlocked.
[*] If you play a level multiple times, the score only gets updated if you achieve a new record.
[*] A new machine, the washer, is now available.
[/list]

However, the biggest change - the main reason it took so long for this update - you won't notice since it's in the background. We completely reworked the way levels are created and loaded into the game. As of now, this is no benefit for the player, BUT, it is the base for a much bigger addition which will hopefully be part of the next update: Steam Workshop integration with a level editor!

Happy playing to everybody!

notes.title: Update 1 - Translations
notes.notes:
Greetings Engineers

We are happy to announce our first minor update. Here is the list of changes:

- Translations: we have localized the game in German, French and Russian
- Environment: the first step towards a better looking environment is done; it now looks much more like a factory.
- Settings: it was clear that we needed to provide players with the possibility to customize some aspects like the window mode and the music volume; that's now possible.

There have been some minor GUI improvements too but most of them won't be directly visible.
Unfortunately we didn't come around to finish some more levels ːsteamsadː
We will do our best to give you more work as soon as possible.

Remember that you can talk with us and other community members directly via telegram!
